# AuraMusic
> Free, Ad-Free Offline Android Music Player

AuraMusic is a native Android music player designed for listening without advertising, subscription requirements, or third-party cloud scrapers. It features direct on-device audio stream resolution, offline downloads, synced lyrics, local music file management, and native AndroidX Media3 integration.

## Key Facts
- Platform: Android 7.0+ (API 24+)
- Target SDK: 36
- Maintainer: Abhishek (@helloabhishek2004)
- Canonical Repository: https://github.com/helloabhishek2004/AuraMusic
- Official Website: https://listenwith-auramusic.vercel.app/
- Current Version: v2.0.0
- Primary Package: com.anonymous.AuraMusic
- APK File: AuraMusic-v2.0.0-universal.apk (110.2 MB)
- Direct Download: https://github.com/helloabhishek2004/AuraMusic/releases/download/v2.0.0/AuraMusic-v2.0.0-universal.apk
- License / Source Status: Source-available personal project on GitHub.

## Core Capabilities
- 100% Free & Ad-Free: Zero advertisements inside the app, zero promotional banners, and no subscription tiers.
- Offline Playback: Download songs and albums directly to device storage with full embedded metadata for offline listening without internet.
- Local Music Library: Scans and plays device audio files (MP3, FLAC, WAV, AAC) via Android MediaStore.
- AndroidX Media3 Core: Audio decoding and playback run on the native Android audio thread with hardware acceleration.
- Synced Lyrics: Line-by-line vocal tracking powered by LRCLIB with offline caching.
- Lock-Screen & Notification Controls: Native MediaSession controls with like/unlike action integration.

## Limitations & Scope
- Distributed via direct APK release, not Google Play Store.
- Requires enabling third-party APK installation in Android settings.
- Third-party music and lyrics availability depends on external API endpoint reachability.
